organizations.name: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

application_types.name: Post-Graduate Merit-cum-Means Scholarship
application_types.description: Institutional scholarship for technical & management postgraduate candidates with income ceiling checks.

required_document_types.label: National Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Passport / Voter ID)
required_document_types.description: Official government photo identification displaying full name and date of birth.

required_document_types.label: Revenue Authority Income Certificate
required_document_types.description: Income proof issued by Tehsildar or competent revenue authority valid for current fiscal year.

required_document_types.label: Undergraduate Final Degree Marksheet
required_document_types.description: Certified transcript or degree certificate displaying graduation marks/grade.

application_types.name: AICTE Institutional Program Approval & Verification
application_types.description: Annual verification and mandatory compliance audit for technical education programs.

required_document_types.label: Previous Year AICTE Extension of Approval (EoA)
required_document_types.description: Copy of preceding academic session approval letter.

required_document_types.label: Building Fire & Structural Safety Certificate
required_document_types.description: Valid certificate issued by Municipal Fire Safety Department.

application_types.name: Enterprise Vendor & Supplier KYC Verification
application_types.description: Commercial supplier onboarding, tax registration, and identity audit.

required_document_types.label: Entity PAN Card
required_document_types.description: Clear copy of business or authorized director PAN card.

required_document_types.label: Certificate of Incorporation / Registration
required_document_types.description: MCA certificate of incorporation or MSME Udyam registration.

application_types.name: AICTE Extension of Approval (EoA) — Existing Institution
application_types.description: Annual statutory Extension of Approval for existing technical institutions under AICTE Approval Process Handbook (APH) 2026-27.

required_document_types.label: Preceding Session AICTE Extension of Approval (EoA) Order
required_document_types.description: Official AICTE EoA approval letter issued for the preceding academic cycle.

required_document_types.label: State Government Concurrence / NOC
required_document_types.description: Valid No Objection Certificate from State Technical Education Department.

required_document_types.label: Affiliating University Annual Affiliation Order
required_document_types.description: Current affiliation letter from the affiliating state/central university.

required_document_types.label: Municipal Fire Safety Clearance Certificate
required_document_types.description: Current fire and life safety certificate issued by competent authority.

required_document_types.label: Land Title & Built-up Instructional Area Affidavit
required_document_types.description: Notarized affidavit conforming to AICTE land norms and ownership.

required_document_types.label: Technical Education Regulatory (TER) Fee Receipt
required_document_types.description: Proof of statutory processing fee payment to AICTE.

required_document_types.label: Mandatory Anti-Ragging Institutional Undertaking
required_document_types.description: Prescribed undertaking on prevention and prohibition of ragging.

application_types.name: AICTE Program Expansion & Increase in Intake
application_types.description: Application for introduction of new courses, division expansion, or supernumerary seat intake.

required_document_types.label: National Board of Accreditation (NBA) Certificate
required_document_types.description: Mandatory valid NBA accreditation certificate for the eligible course.

required_document_types.label: University NOC for Additional Intake / Course
required_document_types.description: Affiliating university concurrence for increased capacity.

required_document_types.label: TER Expansion Processing Fee Receipt
required_document_types.description: Payment voucher for program expansion evaluation.

compliance_rules.name: Mandatory Documents Completeness
compliance_rules.description: Verifies that all required documents specified for the application type are uploaded and readable.
compliance_rules.remediation: Please upload all missing required supporting documents.

compliance_rules.name: Annual Income Eligibility Ceiling
compliance_rules.description: Mandatory verification that family annual income declared does not exceed INR 8,00,000 threshold for means-based assistance.
compliance_rules.remediation: Applicant income exceeds the scheme cap (INR 8,00,000). Manual review or exception certificate required.

compliance_rules.name: Minimum Qualifying Academic Score
compliance_rules.description: Ensures undergraduate academic score meets minimum threshold of 60% or 6.5 GPA.
compliance_rules.remediation: Academic score is below the minimum qualifying merit threshold.

compliance_rules.name: Identity Name Concordance
compliance_rules.description: Cross-validates that the name extracted from government ID proof matches the declared applicant name.
compliance_rules.remediation: Ensure the name on the ID card matches your application legal name or provide gazetted name change proof.

compliance_rules.name: Document Expiration & Currency
compliance_rules.description: Verifies that supporting certificates, licenses, or approvals have not passed their expiry date.
compliance_rules.remediation: Renew and re-upload the expired certificate before proceeding.

compliance_rules.name: AICTE Faculty-to-Student Cadre Ratio
compliance_rules.description: Mandates minimum approved faculty count relative to total institutional student intake (APH 2026-27 Clause 2.4).
compliance_rules.jurisdiction: AICTE Approval Process Handbook 2026-27, Chapter II
compliance_rules.remediation: Total faculty count is below the statutory cadre quota. Recruit qualified faculty according to AICTE pay scales.

compliance_rules.name: Minimum Campus Land Area Compliance
compliance_rules.description: Verifies that institutional contiguous land parcel satisfies AICTE norms (minimum 2.5 acres for Technical Engineering programs).
compliance_rules.jurisdiction: AICTE Approval Process Handbook 2026-27, Chapter I
compliance_rules.remediation: Land area declared is below the statutory threshold (2.5 acres). Rectify land registry records or provide exemption.

compliance_rules.name: Mandatory Fire & Structural Safety Currency
compliance_rules.description: Statutory requirement that building fire safety clearance is active and unexpired (APH Appendix 6).
compliance_rules.remediation: Renew and furnish valid municipal fire safety clearance certificate prior to approval consideration.
